Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Fluorinated AlPO4 surface coating on Li-rich layered oxides uniquely combines oxygen-framework stabilization with interfacial charge redistribution, enhancing Li affinity and structural reversibility. This yields 95.9% initial Coulombic efficiency, 244-cycle stability versus 57 for pristine, and reduced voltage decay (0.23 V), offering a multifunctional strategy for high-capacity anionic-redox cathodes.

item.title: Functional‐Group Engineering for Durable Solid Electrolyte Interphase Toward Aqueous Copper Batteries
item.description:
با مهندسی گروههای عاملی، یک SEI هیبریدی آلی-معدنی روی الکترود Cu ساخته شد که برگشتپذیری Cu2+ و پایداری باتری آبی مس را بهشدت بهبود میدهد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers functional-group engineering of an organic-inorganic hybrid SEI on Cu electrodes for aqueous copper batteries. By combining fluorine and sulfur additives, it achieves high modulus (54.7 GPa) and fast Cu²⁺ transport, enabling 2000 h cycling and 2200-cycle full cells. This establishes a structure-function relationship guiding durable SEI design, advancing practical aqueous copper battery deployment.
🏷 aqueous copper battery · solid electrolyte interphase · functional-group engineering · Cu2+ reversibility · fluorinated additives

item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 ε-MnO₂ acts as both an ion-storage cathode for rechargeable seawater batteries and a photothermal material for solar desalination. Integrating the two yields a mutual enhancement effect: battery capacity and seawater evaporation both increase during charge/discharge, unlike traditional integrations. This bifunctional coupling offers a new strategy for combined energy storage and clean water production.
